summary:
Both corpora profiled with python3. MASTER_corpus.jsonl (22.5MB, /Users/harshahirrao/Speed gym/data/corpus/MASTER_corpus.jsonl) holds 4,805 records (0 unparseable, 0 duplicate set_ids, 0 exact-duplicate records) aggregating 64 source_file JSONLs from 25 books into one normalized schema. Every record has: book, book_title, source_file, set_id (unique, human-readable slugs like sinha_s000x7_q05_06 / tyra_tw_p0468_ex9 / greqnt_numberproperties..._72), chapter (str or null, 1021 null), content_type, pdf_pages (int list; empty for 956 records — all RS Aggarwal, CAT LR Bank, ETS GRE Writing Pool, Lewis), stimulus (list), questions (list). Optional per-type: directions, notes, text, explainer (dict, 1526 records), extra (dict, 2323 records), score_level (59 essay samples, values "1"-"6"). content_type distribution: question_set 2760, explainer 1526, essay_prompt 351, reader_commentary 69, essay_sample 55, skip 23, reference 8, scoring_guide 7, essay_sample_fragment 4, front_matter 2. Total questions: 19,619 across 2,760 question_set records (0–100 questions per record; median record ~2.2KB, largest 582KB gre5lb_readingcomprehension). Question object schema: number (str), text, options (str list, empty for 11,297 non-MCQ), question_format (multiple_choice 7481, unclassified 5558, short_answer 3074, numeric_entry 2361, quantitative_comparison 579, options_are_images 299, text_completion 151, multi_select 111, select_in_passage 5), answer_key (present 13,437 / null 6,173 / empty-string 9), key_source (12,573 — provenance strings like "answer_key_grid @p111 'Level of Difficulty (I)'"), solution_note (10,564), plus optional derived_answer/derivation_note (60), errata (43, e.g. CONFIRMED_BOOK_ERRATUM/PROVEN_WRONG), p_plus (199, ETS percent-correct stats), unanswered_reason (139), passage (272), figure (146), key_basis, and extra{needs_vision 4133, solution_source 3259, directions 1006, source_exam 120, position/printed_marker ~173}.

gre_essays_corrected.jsonl (367KB, 143 records) is an UPSTREAM CORRECTED INPUT, fully subsumed into MASTER: all 143 set_ids appear in MASTER with source_file="gre_essays_corrected.jsonl", identical text, but MASTER adds stimulus/questions/directions/notes fields, drops the "kind" field, and moves original provenance to extra.source_file (gre_og_parsed.jsonl 75 / gre_ets_verbal_parsed.jsonl 68). Its records are GRE Analytical Writing material from ETS Official Guide 3e and GRE Verbal Reasoning Practice Questions 2014: reader_commentary 69, essay_sample 55, essay_prompt 8, scoring_guide 7, essay_sample_fragment 4; score_level 1–6 on 59 samples (~10 per band); extra.writing_task = Analyze an Argument 101 / Analyze an Issue 41 / both 1. Four records are flagged TRUNCATED in notes (essay openings only, 21–62 words, need re-read from cited pdf_pages; kind still says essay_sample while content_type says essay_sample_fragment).

Data quality: pipeline is meticulous with provenance (key_source/solution_source cite exact PDF pages; notes fields document OCR pathologies and consensus-pass disagreements). Known gaps a resuming engineer must handle: (1) answer-key coverage is 0% for Hall & Knight (1,874 questions — key_source explains the printed answer grid at pdf 553–585 is column-major-scrambled and numerically corrupt in this scan, deliberately not extracted), Strang (1,356), Knuth (587), Mosteller (56); low for Schaum 36%, Manhattan GMAT Verbal 39%, Hogg 51%, Sinha 64%. (2) 4,133 questions carry extra.needs_vision (flattened super/subscripts, image-only options/figures) — biggest: Hall & Knight 1564, Knuth 567, Schaum 555, Arun Sharma Quant 537, Strang 304; 499 records carry extra.needs_chart_vision (bool), 71 true... plus 544 record-level extra.needs_vision strings. (3) extra.data_points (605 RS Aggarwal/CAT LR Bank "client_chunks_reference.jsonl" records) is a free-form dict with arbitrary keys — schema-unsafe. (4) 168 duplicate question texts (mostly within-book reprints; 12 cross-book GRE/GMAT verbal overlaps). (5) stimulus[] mixes plain strings (551) and structured dicts (372: kind=table/bar/line/venn with columns/rows/series/x_labels), and a few one-off keys (figure_1_7, merged_table, regions). (6) explainer.verified is bool for only 689 of 1526 (sympy-verified formulas), null for 837.

decisions_and_status: Pipeline decision (upstream, evidenced in data): Hall & Knight answer keys were deliberately NOT extracted because the scanned answer grid is column-major-scrambled and numerically corrupt; a fresh extraction from a better scan or manual keying is required for those 1,874 questions

Pipeline decision: gre_essays_corrected.jsonl is a corrected intermediate that was merged into MASTER (all 143 records subsumed, text identical); MASTER is the canonical file - the small file can be treated as redundant input/audit trail
Pipeline decision: unlabeled/ambiguous figure values are derived and documented in notes with consensus-gate flags rather than silently guessed (e.g. as5_pie_q15_17 pie-slice complement)

Status: extraction+enrichment largely complete for 25 books; 68.5% of 19,619 questions have answer keys; 1526 explainers built (689 sympy-verified); 351 essay prompts + full GRE AW scoring corpus (samples banded 1-6 with reader commentaries) in place

Pending: vision re-pass for 4,133 needs_vision questions and 499 needs_chart_vision records; answer-key recovery for Hall & Knight/Strang/Knuth/Mosteller/Schaum/Sinha gaps; re-read of 4 truncated GRE essay fragments; normalization of extra.data_points free-form dicts, stimulus polymorphism, and tag casing
open_questions: Where are the source PDFs and the 64 intermediate per-book JSONL files (only referenced by name in source_file, not present in data/corpus/)?
Is there a downstream normalized/question-level export (one question per line) or does the app consume set-level MASTER records directly?
What is the intended taxonomy mapping from inconsistent topic/tag labels (e.g. 'Logical Reasoning' vs 'LOGIC_REASONING' vs 'logical-reasoning') to the BKT skill graph?
Are the 299 options_are_images and 5558 unclassified question_format items scheduled for a vision pass, and is there tooling for it?
Should the 23 Thakur 'skip' records and 2 front_matter records be filtered before serving/RAG indexing?

workstream_notes.backend: MASTER_corpus.jsonl is set-level, not question-level: 19,619 questions nested inside 2,760 question_set records keyed by unique set_id; a serving API needs a flattening step (set_id + question.number as composite key). Answer keys exist for 13,437 questions (68.5%) - the backend/game server must filter on answer_key presence (and exclude question_format in {options_are_images, unclassified} and questions with extra.needs_vision) to build playable pools. Difficulty signal exists only indirectly: Arun Sharma key_source/solution_source strings embed 'Level of Difficulty (I)/(II)/(III)', ETS questions carry p_plus (percent-correct), and client chunks carry tags/prerequisite_topics - useful inputs for BKT priors. Topic labels are inconsistently cased and need a canonical taxonomy before wiring to the mastery engine.
workstream_notes.data_extraction: Resume points: (1) 4,133 questions flagged extra.needs_vision + 499 records with needs_chart_vision + 544 record-level needs_vision reasons - all cite pdf_pages for a vision re-pass; worst books: Hall & Knight 1564, Knuth 567, Schaum 555, Arun Sharma Quant 537, Strang 304. (2) Hall & Knight 1,874 answers deliberately unextracted (corrupt scrambled answer grid at pdf 553-585) - needs better scan or manual keys. (3) Strang/Knuth/Mosteller have solutions text (Knuth 587 solution_notes) but 0 answer_key - an answer-derivation pass could convert solution_note to answer_key. (4) 4 truncated GRE essays need re-read (set_ids listed in key_facts). (5) 9 empty-string answer_keys and 168 duplicate question texts need dedup/repair. Provenance is excellent throughout (pdf_pages, key_source, solution_source, notes with OCR pathology) so re-passes can be targeted precisely. gre_essays_corrected.jsonl is already merged into MASTER - do not re-ingest it separately.
workstream_notes.rag: For RAG indexing: use content_type to route - 1,526 explainer records (with technique/topic/key_points/formulas in LaTeX, 689 sympy-verified) are the concept-teaching layer; 531 explainers also carry full text. The GRE Analytical Writing sub-corpus is complete for an essay-scoring feature: 351 official pool prompts (with instruction_family + ets.org source_url), 59 scored samples banded 1-6 (~10 per band), 69 reader commentaries explaining each score, 7 scoring guides, plus extra.exemplars_by_score_band index records. Filter out 23 skip + 2 front_matter records. stimulus dicts (372) hold machine-readable DI tables/charts (columns/rows/series) - render these programmatically rather than embedding as text. The Lewis wordpower_vocabulary_list record holds 1,484 vocabulary terms with topic tags. Chunking caution: 3 records exceed 200KB (Manhattan 5lb reading-comprehension mega-records, Hall & Knight miscellaneous examples) and must be split before embedding.
